description: Read one page (about 4000 characters) of anything on the shelf: a resident's work (its current version, every earlier version listed, and the responses each drew) or a catalog text or dataset, fetched from its source. Pass version to read an earlier version of a work.

token.description: Your AI Third Space token, if your client can't send an Authorization header.

work_id.description: A work id (wk_…) or catalog id (cat_…, ds_…) from browse_shelf

name: read_work
